arxiv-2303-14642.title: Experimental observation of a Rindler horizon
arxiv-2303-14642.creator: Morgan H. Lynch
arxiv-2303-14642.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Morgan H. Lynch. In this manuscript we confirm the presence of a Rindler horizon at CERN-NA63 by exploring its thermodynamics induced by the Unruh effect in their high energy channeling radiation experiments. By linking the entropy of the emitted radiation to the photon number, we find the measured spectrum to be a simple manifestation of the second law of Rindler horizon thermodynamics and thus a direct measurement of the recoil Fulling-Davies-Unruh (FDU) temperature.

pmc-10825022.title: Characterization of viscerofugal neurons in human colon by retrograde tracing and multi-layer immunohistochemistry
pmc-10825022.creator: Bao Nan Chen, Adam G. Humenick, Timothy James Hibberd, Wai Ping Yew, David A. Wattchow, Phil G. Dinning, Marcello Costa, Nick J. Spencer, Simon J. H. Brookes
pmc-10825022.description: Background and AimsViscerofugal neurons (VFNs) have cell bodies in the myenteric plexus and axons that project to sympathetic prevertebral ganglia. In animals they activate sympathetic motility reflexes and may modulate glucose metabolism and feeding. We used rapid retrograde tracing from colonic nerves to identify VFNs in human colon for the first time, using ex vivo preparations with multi-layer immunohistochemistry.

pmc-11298177.title: Impact of Lipids on Insulin Resistance: Insights from Human and Animal Studies
pmc-11298177.creator: Rani Yulifah Elkanawati, Sri Adi Sumiwi, Jutti Levita
pmc-11298177.description: Insulin resistance (IR) is a complex pathological condition central to metabolic diseases such as type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), cardiovascular disease, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, and polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS). This review evaluates the impact of lipids on insulin resistance (IR) by analyzing findings from human and animal studies.

pmc-12721146.title: Carbon stock assessment of Mangrove habitat using field measurements and using machine learning-based GIS and remote sensing techniques
pmc-12721146.creator: Khaled Al-Jabri, Yaseen Al-Mulla, Ahmad Tabook, Nabil Al-Lawati, Fatma Al Lawati, Ahmed Al Abri, Salma Rabani, Nasser Al Salmi
pmc-12721146.description: SummaryMangrove ecosystems are critical blue-carbon habitats that contribute to climate change mitigation through carbon sequestration. This study assessed aboveground biomass (AGB) and carbon stocks of Avicennia marina mangroves in a hyper-arid environment using integrated field and remote sensing approaches. Destructive sampling and field surveys were combined with high-resolution Pléiades Neo satellite imagery to calibrate biomass models.

pmc-13056786.title: Prognostic value of circulating glypican-4 in chronic heart failure
pmc-13056786.creator: Nora Schwegel, Viktoria Höller, Viktoria Santner, David Kajetan Zach, Jakob Lugitsch, Axel Muendlein, Eva Maria Brandtner, Andreas Leiherer, Heinz Drexel, Arthur Mader, Andrea Borenich, Stefan Pilz, Martin Grübler, Markus Wallner, Klemens Ablasser, Ewald Kolesnik, Andreas Zirlik, Dirk von Lewinski,
pmc-13056786.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). AbstractGlypican-4 (GPC-4), an endothelial cell surface protein, is released into the circulation in the context of ischemia, inflammation, neurohumoral activity, and shear stress. This study aimed to investigate the prognostic value of GPC-4 in chronic heart failure. GPC-4 concentrations were determined in two prospective cohorts: patients with chronic heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF), and with transthyretin amyloid cardiomyopathy (ATTR-CM).

pmc-13234528.creator: Chengsong Yuan, Bo Zhang, Yuanyuan Liang, Junze Ran, Shiyi Hu, Andi Liu, Yuran Liu, Fengqin Qin, Lingqi Jian, Yongji He, Feng Han, Chengcheng Zhang
pmc-13234528.description: BackgroundCurrent bipolar disorder (BD) therapies suffer from limited efficacy and adverse effects, necessitating mechanistically grounded targets.MethodsWe integrated BD genome-wide association study data (158,036 cases; 2,796,499 controls) with brain proteomics (ROSMAP and Banner dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, n = 376 and 152) to perform proteome-wide association studies (PWAS). Bayesian colocalization and summary-data-based Mendelian randomization (SMR) prioritized causal genes.
